result.topic_en: Gauss introduces the roots ξ, η, ζ of the cubic (u³+u)/(uu−1) = √(αβγδε) in place of the earlier quantities G°, G′, G″ (pentagramma mirificum context), gives their numerical values for αβγδε = 20, and expresses the coordinates of the inner and outer spherical pentagons in terms of them.
